Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Error messages now follow the request's `Accept-Language` header, and all 10 error codes have Korean messages. If the header is missing, is `*`, or names no supported language, it falls back to `LARDER_LANG`. `src/http/server.js` uses it to pick the language.
